description: Single retiree age 70 with Social Security, a small pension and interest: provisional income under the 25,000 base, so no benefits are taxable; full senior deduction; no taxable income.
worked:
Line numbers are those of the 2025 Form 1040, its instructions' worksheets and Schedule 1-A; the figures are the 2026 ones from the federal file.
Filing status: single.
Taxpayer: born 1956-12-05, age 70 at the end of 2026.
Form 1040: line 2b taxable interest 1,000; lines 4b + 5b taxable pensions and IRA distributions 10,000; line 6a Social Security benefits 24,000.
Social Security Benefits Worksheet (Form 1040 instructions, lines 6a and 6b; Publication 915 Worksheet 1):
  line 1 = 24,000; line 2 = 50% x 24,000 = 12,000
  line 3 (lines 1z, 2b, 3b, 4b, 5b, 7a, 8) = 11,000; line 4 (line 2a) = 0
  line 5 = 12,000 + 11,000 + 0 = 23,000; line 6 (Schedule 1 adjustments) = 0; line 7 = 23,000
  line 8 (base amount, single) = 25,000
  line 9: 25,000 is not less than 23,000, so none of the benefits are taxable; line 6b = 0
Form 1040 line 9 total income = 1,000 + 10,000 = 11,000; line 10 adjustments 0; line 11a/11b adjusted gross income = 11,000.
Line 12e standard deduction = 16,100 basic (single) + 1 x 2,050 additional (unmarried amount, one per box checked on line 12d for age 65 or older / blind) = 18,150.
Schedule 1-A: line 1 = line 11b 11,000; line 3 MAGI = 11,000 (no excluded income).
  Part V: line 31 = 11,000; line 32 = 75,000; line 33: 11,000 - 75,000 is zero or less, so line 35 = 6,000
  line 36a (born before January 2, 1962) = 6,000; line 37 = 6,000 -> line 38 -> Form 1040 line 13b
Line 14 = 18,150 + 6,000 = 24,150; line 15 taxable income = 11,000 - 24,150 = less than zero, so 0.
Form 1040 line 16 (regular tax): tax on 0 = 0
Form 8960: lines 8 and 12 net investment income = 1,000; line 13 MAGI = 11,000; line 14 threshold = 200,000; line 15 = 11,000 - 200,000, zero or less, so 0; line 17 net investment income tax = 0.
Form 8959: no wages or self-employment income; additional Medicare tax 0.
Total tax = 0 regular + 0 net investment income tax + 0 additional Medicare tax = 0.
